dialog.title: Prompt
dialog.placeholder: What goes here? A few words is enough. Enter for a new line.
dialog.hint: Esc saves · ⌘⏎ saves · ⇧Esc puts the text back
dialog.hintFresh: Esc saves · ⌘⏎ saves · ⇧Esc removes this new marker
dialog.saveFailed: The prompt could not be saved; see the console.
dialog.deleteFailed: The prompt marker could not be deleted; see the console.
dialog.noActor: No "Prompt · {size}" actor in this world. Reload as GM to recreate it.

panel.failed: Could not compute what this marker sees; see the console.

typeahead.orphan: Typed before a prompt box opened and not used: "{text}"

keybind.placeHint: Drops a prompt marker of your default size under the cursor and opens its text box.
keybind.editHint: Opens the text box of the prompt marker under the cursor.

panelRows.name: Side panel rows
panelRows.hint: How many things the dialog lists before "+N more".

panelChars.name: Side panel preview length
panelChars.hint: Characters of text shown per row in the dialog's side panel.

gatherChars.name: Gather description length
gatherChars.hint: Characters of a built thing's description included in the gather text (cut at a sentence end).

party.name: Party for encounter budgets
party.hint: Size x level, e.g. 4x5 (or blank). The gather prints the 2024 DMG XP budget per encounter and replace reports each encounter's difficulty. A gather's own party argument wins.

unseenWithinFt.name: Out-of-sight radius (ft)
unseenWithinFt.hint: Things behind a wall or door are still listed when they are this close.

cropMaxPerCall.name: Crops per gather
cropMaxPerCall.hint: Most encounter images one gather returns.

cropLongSidePx.name: Crop size (px)
cropLongSidePx.hint: Long side of each encounter image. 768 is about 790 image tokens.

cropsDefault.name: Encounter images
cropsDefault.hint: Auto: images when exactly one scene is gathered.

deleteEmptyOnClose.name: Remove empty new markers
deleteEmptyOnClose.hint: A freshly dropped marker closed with no text is deleted.

defaultSize.name: Prompt marker size for the P key
defaultSize.hint: Which marker the P key places.
